Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Welcome back ladies and gentlemen to this thrilling matchup between The Gatewatch and The Eldrazi at breathtaking Hedron Park on Zendikar. The stands are filled with goblins, elves, and kor—I think I even see a few vampires skulking under the bleachers.

Folks we have a mana burner on our hands. Garruk Wildspeaker is leading off with Liliana Vess on deck. Fans are excited to see explosive play from Chandra Nalaar and the return of Ajani Goldmane to The Gatewatch. And as always, we expect Jace Beleren to play some mind games from the mound.

Couldn’t ask for a better day for baseball.

Art by Fay Dalton & Scott Okumura

Contents:
• 1x Foil Ajani Goldmane
• 1x Foil Jace Beleren
• 1x Foil Liliana Vess
• 1x Foil Chandra Nalaar
• 1x Foil Garruk Wildspeaker
